appDescription.message: Capture Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Zoom audio for local transcription in the Kuali desktop app.

kualiClosed.message: Kuali is closed or the pairing code does not match

captureDisclosure.message: Kuali will send participant audio and identity to the local desktop app to transcribe this meeting.

destinationDisclosure.message: Depending on your settings, the app may also save local audio tracks, the visible tab, and technical diagnostics. None of those files are sent to an AI provider or webhook.

consentConfirmation.message: I confirm that I informed the participants and have permission to record and transcribe.

pairingHint.message: Copy it from Kuali → Settings → Integrations.

recordSuggestionAria.message: Kuali suggestion to record the meeting

recordSuggestionDescription.message: Live local transcription and a summary when it ends

consentDetailed.message: Kuali will capture participant audio and identity —name, photo, and platform ID— and send them to the Kuali app on this computer to transcribe the meeting.

destinationDetailed.message: Depending on your settings, the app may also save local audio tracks, the visible tab, and technical diagnostics. Only the transcript and its results may go to the AI provider or webhook you configured.

consentDetailedConfirmation.message: I confirm that I informed the participants and have permission to record and transcribe this meeting.

unsupportedMeetingError.message: This tab is not a supported meeting.

mixedCaptureDeniedError.message: Chrome could not prepare mixed capture. Try again from this tab.

screenChunkTooLargeError.message: A screen recording chunk exceeded the local safety limit.

missingPairingCodeError.message: Enter the 32-character pairing code from Kuali Settings before recording.

connectionError.message: Could not connect to Kuali on this computer. Open the app and try again.
